nodes.body: There is no special construct for modeling "signals". Data to be transmitted asynchronously can simply be modeled using attribute defs.
Black box definitions for actions include their inputs and outputs.
These successions act to "enable" the torque-related actions. Each action on the right can only be performed following the completion of a performance of 'engineStarted'.
These successions act to "disable" the torque-related actions. The performance of the actions on the left cannot continue once there is a performance of 'engineStopped'.
An action usage inherits parameters from its definition. They act as its "pins".
